{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|According to the shipping manifest I sliced, Gorvax should be coming out of hyperspace in 3.4 minutes. Charge up the tractor beam.|A locator tracks down Gorvax|<ref name="PGT">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>}}
'''Gorvax''' was an individual who was being tracked by a [[Locator (occupation)|Locator]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who specialized in finding people who wanted to remain hidden. The locator [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] information on Gorvax's intended flight path, and planned to ambush Gorvax by ensnaring them in a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] once they had dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="PGT" />
